hotel_partnerships_window_check.name: hotel_partnerships_window_check
hotel_partnerships_window_check.value: "hotel_partnerships"."starts_at" is null or "hotel_partnerships"."ends_at" is null or "hotel_partnerships"."ends_at" > "hotel_partnerships"."starts_at"

qr_credentials_active_hotel_idx.name: qr_credentials_active_hotel_idx
qr_credentials_active_hotel_idx.where: "qr_credentials"."revoked_at" is null and "qr_credentials"."hotel_id" is not null

qr_credentials_active_place_idx.name: qr_credentials_active_place_idx
qr_credentials_active_place_idx.where: "qr_credentials"."revoked_at" is null and "qr_credentials"."place_id" is not null

qr_credentials_subject_matches_purpose_c.name: qr_credentials_subject_matches_purpose_check
qr_credentials_subject_matches_purpose_c.value:
("qr_credentials"."purpose" = 'hotel_entry' and "qr_credentials"."hotel_id" is not null and "qr_credentials"."place_id" is null)
          or ("qr_credentials"."purpose" = 'place_check_in' and "qr_credentials"."place_id" is not null and "qr_credentials"."hotel_id" is null)

place_models_anchor_region_check.name: place_models_anchor_region_check
place_models_anchor_region_check.value: "place_models"."anchor_latitude" is null or ("place_models"."anchor_latitude" between 40.9 and 43.7 and "place_models"."anchor_longitude" between 39.9 and 46.9)
